question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the female reproductive system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vas deferens**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Vas deferens is not part of the female reproductive system: 
 
• Vas deferens is a part of the male reproductive system.
 
• It is also known as the sperm duct or ductus deferens.
 
• Vas deferens is a muscular tube that carries sperm from the epididymis to the urethra.
